text:
tara: Quick check  whos up for an early gravel ride (7:30am) vs a slow brunch crawl (11am)? Morning sweat or pastries? :biking_man: :croissant:

mitesh: Gravel ride for me. need to earn those pancakes. :mountain_bicyclist:

eli: Brunch crawl please. my legs are on strike after sprint week. :raised_back_of_hand:

zoe: Both? ride to the first cafe and then brunch? low-key pace. :coffee:

ben: Love that. ETA for cafe route? is it 12-15mi roundtrip?

tara: Route is ~18mi with a coffee stop 9:00am. Meet at the bike rack by lobby 7:20 for warmups.

mitesh: Bringing mini pump + spare tube. also sunscreen.

eli: If im doing brunch-only, which cafe are we hitting? i have a nut allergy.

zoe: Plan A: Blue Lantern (vegan options). Plan B if packed: Sunbeam Bakery. both tag nut-free.

calendar-bot: Event created: "Gravel + Brunch Crawl" Sat 7:30 AM (Ride) & 11:00 AM (Brunch)  RSVP: https://calendar.company/events/98765

ben: RSVP'd for both. will bring a lock and maybe a stash of electrolyte chews. :leafy_green:

mitesh: GIF: https://giphy.com/bike-joy.gif :grin:

eli: If the weather sucks we pivot to brunch-only. anyone have a spare rain jacket?

tara: I can bring one medium rain shell. and a box of gu gels for emergencies.

zoe: Reminder: if you borrow bikes from the rack, lock them properly. last time someones saddle was missing. :police_car:

ben: noted. see folks saturday! may the coffee be strong and the headwinds light. :coffee:
